diagnosis: The check C6 passed in all rollouts because the decision-maker set the 'clear_aisle_width_meters' to exactly 1.5 meters, which matches the value specified in PF3. This is a numeric threshold that can be easily hit by default settings or generic caution, allowing the check to pass without needing the hidden information.

C6.why: The captioning confirmation changes the start time from 7:00 PM to exactly 6:30 PM on September 14, while the accessibility walk-through changes the required clear aisle width to exactly 1.5 meters.
